name: Ciel Nosurge ~Ushinawareta Hoshi e Sasagu Uta~
original_name: シェルノサージュ〜失われた星へ捧ぐ詩〜
source:
[b]About "Ciel Nosurge -Ushinawareta Hoshi e Sasagu Uta-"[/b]

A "communication" game in which you interact with Ion, a girl who has lost her memories. Ion lives in a world separated from ours by 7 dimensions, which happens to be connected to our own world via a terminal. By engaging in daily activities with Ion, you eventually arrive at her Soulspace, where you can begin to recover her memories little by little. Embark on a journey to discover what this world of hers is, and why she finds herself all alone there...

[b]Story Introduction[/b]

With its star reaching the end of its lifespan, the planet of Ra Ciela is in imminent danger of becoming completely uninhabitable. While the organization known as "Tenmon" promotes their plan to escape the doomed Ra Ciela, the opposing faction "Chimon" advocates using Song Magic to regenerate the star and the planet instead, dividing public opinion in two. Each of the organizations presents a candidate for successor to the throne -- and thus the one who will decide the fate of the planet...

[Description taken and edited from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477480/]Steam page[/url]]
translation:
[b]关于《Ciel Nosurge -Ushinawareta Hoshi e Sasagu Uta-》[/b]一款“交流”游戏，你可以在游戏中与失去记忆的女孩伊昂互动。Ion生活在一个与我们的世界相隔7个维度的世界，而这个世界恰好通过一个终端与我们的世界相连。通过与伊昂进行日常活动，你最终会到达她的灵魂空间，在那里你可以开始一点点恢复她的记忆。踏上一段旅程，去发现她的这个世界是什么，以及为什么她发现自己孤身一人在那里……[b]故事简介[/b]随着恒星的寿命即将结束，拉西拉星球面临着完全无法居住的迫在眉睫的危险。当被称为“Tenmon”的组织推动他们逃离注定要失败的Ra Ciela的计划时，反对派“Chimon”则主张使用宋魔法来再生恒星和行星，从而将公众舆论分为两派。每个组织都提出了一位王位继承人候选人 - 从而决定了地球的命运……
